# Budget Book

> Budget Book is a free, open-source (MIT) budget management web app for individuals, households and teams. It is self-hosted on MySQL and built with React, Redux Toolkit, Express and Knex. It began in March 2023 as a university team final-year project and was rebuilt in 2026.

## What it does

- Monthly budgets split by category, with planned, spent and remaining amounts; several named budgets per month
- Expense and transaction tracking with search, filters and Excel or CSV import
- Month-end spending forecast based on the current pace and past months
- Bill reminders that repeat weekly, monthly or yearly, with alerts before they are due; paying one records it in a budget
- Monthly reports with Excel and PDF downloads
- Personal and organization workspaces with owner, admin and member roles
- AI assistant: scan a receipt photo into an expense, and get a plain-language summary of a month. Works with the user's own Claude, ChatGPT (OpenAI), Gemini or DeepSeek API key, stored encrypted
- 20 currencies

## Integrations

- Excel (.xlsx) and CSV import and export
- PDF monthly reports
- Google Sheets live feed through IMPORTDATA
- Calendar feed (.ics) for Google Calendar, Outlook and Apple Calendar
- Slack, Discord and signed webhook notifications, compatible with Zapier and Make
